summary: Retest of code-quality fixes: identity-comparison audit in backend, simplified lifespan(), console-log-free server.js with named constants, and typed test functions. All criteria verified via static inspection plus re-run of backend pytest suite and 2 relevant existing browser checks. No regressions.

checks.criterion: Backend has no incorrect identity comparison against string or numeric literals
checks.name: identity-comparison-inspection
checks.evidence: grep -rn ' is | is not ' /app/backend/*.py -> only match is db.py:145 'if app.state.mongo_client is not None' (valid None-sentinel check, commented as intentional). No `is`/`is not` against string or numeric constants found anywhere in backend/*.py.

checks.name: lifespan-simplification-inspection
checks.evidence: db.py lifespan() (lines ~141-148): calls initialize_storage_state(app), awaits configure_review_storage(app), yields, then closes app.state.mongo_client in finally. All Mongo connection/index/seeding logic lives in separate typed helpers: storage_settings() -> tuple[str,str,bool], connect_mongo_storage(app, mongo_url, db_name, production_mode) -> None, configure_review_storage(app) -> None.

checks.criterion: Frontend production server emits no console logging
checks.name: server-js-no-console-log
checks.evidence: grep console.log /app/frontend/server.js -> no matches. Server confirmed running: GET http://localhost:8001/api/health -> 200 (proxy path validated indirectly via browser checks below which hit /api/* through the frontend origin).

checks.criterion: Frontend server uses named constants instead of magic ports/status codes
checks.name: server-js-named-constants-inspection
checks.evidence: server.js declares DEFAULT_FRONTEND_PORT=3000, BACKEND_PORT=8001, STATUS_OK=200, STATUS_BAD_GATEWAY=502, STATUS_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED=405, STATUS_FORBIDDEN=403, STATUS_NOT_FOUND=404, LOOPBACK_HOST/LISTEN_HOST; all used in proxyApi()/send()/route handling instead of inline literals.

checks.criterion: Priority backend tests have type annotations
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_health.py + test_tscheck_reviews_api.py
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -> 5 passed in 0.55s. Manual inspection: every test function (test_public_health_endpoint_ok, test_health_endpoint_ok, test_reviews_list_contains_seeded_lea_review, test_create_valid_review_is_accepted_and_listed, test_create_review_with_short_name_and_text_and_bad_rating_rejected) has explicit '-> None'; typed payload/response vars use dict[str, object]/list[dict[str, object]].

checks.criterion: Public app and API have no regression
checks.name: home-explains-offline-audit-flow + public-reviews-loaded-from-backend
checks.evidence: GET http://localhost:8001/api/health -> 200 {status:'ok'} (pytest). Browser checks re-run by name (reran-persisted): home-explains-offline-audit-flow PASSED, public-reviews-loaded-from-backend PASSED - homepage renders, reviews fetched from backend via frontend proxy, no crashes.

note: All 6 acceptance criteria confirmed via source inspection (identity comparisons, lifespan structure, console.log absence, named constants) plus re-run of the existing 5-test backend pytest suite (5/5 passed) and 2 pre-existing browser checks (both passed, reran-persisted, no regression). No new UI surface introduced by this round of fixes, so no new browser checks were required beyond the existing public-app regression checks. No bugs found.
